reply:
VARCHAR and TEXT have identical performance in Postgres. Both use varlena encoding. The only difference is VARCHAR enforces a length constraint at write time; TEXT does not.

For read performance, it doesn't matter. Pick TEXT if you want no length limit. Pick VARCHAR(2000) if you want the database to reject writes that exceed 2000 bytes.
